title: Cursed Coop
description: One inventory. One fate.  All players share the same inventory. If one dies, everything is wiped.  Good luck.
body:
⚠ Requires Multiplayer (see below)



One inventory. One fate.

All players share the same inventory.
If one player dies — everything is wiped.

Good luck.





Cursed Co-Op Series

This mod is part of an ongoing series focused on chaotic multiplayer mechanics.

Planned additions:
- Shared health
- Shared durability
- Shared XP
- More cursed systems...



Support

If you enjoy this and want to support development:

 buy me a coffee <3



⚠ Important Notes

- Multiplayer ONLY (for now)
- Must be installed on BOTH server and all clients
- Does NOT currently support singleplayer

Singleplayer support is planned, but requires proper sync design first.

I may also release a simple open-source server setup to make hosting easier.


Thanks for trying it out :D
